governador.nota: Governo interino e por poucos dias. O governador eleito em 2022, Paulo Dantas (MDB), se afastou temporariamente do cargo para tirar férias, segundo o Governo de Alagoas. O g1 diz que Bittencourt fica até 30/10/2026; a Gazeta de Alagoas diz até 22/10/2026. Paulo Dantas não foi candidato em 2026.
governador.nota_en: This is a temporary government that will last only a few days. The governor elected in 2022, Paulo Dantas (MDB), has temporarily stepped away from the job to take a vacation, according to the Alagoas state government. The news site g1 says Bittencourt will stay until October 30, 2026; the newspaper Gazeta de Alagoas says until October 22, 2026. Paulo Dantas was not a candidate in 2026.

governador.nota: Governador interino. Na eleição suplementar de 21/06/2026, o mais votado foi Arthur Henrique (PL), mas a candidatura dele estava sub judice e o TSE suspendeu a diplomação até decisão do STF. Arthur Henrique foi eleito em 04/10/2026 para o mandato que começa em 2027.
governador.nota_en: Acting governor. In the special election (an extra election to fill the post) held on June 21, 2026, the candidate with the most votes was Arthur Henrique (PL), but his candidacy was still under review in court. The TSE (Brazil's Superior Electoral Court) put the official confirmation of the winner on hold until the STF (Brazil's Supreme Court) decides. Arthur Henrique was elected on October 4, 2026, for the term that starts in 2027.

vice.nota: O cargo de vice-governador está vago: o vice eleito em 2022, Edilson Damião, assumiu o governo em abril de 2026, depois da renúncia de Antonio Denarium, e teve o mandato cassado pelo TSE em 30/04/2026.
vice.nota_en: The vice governor post is empty. The vice governor elected in 2022, Edilson Damião, became governor in April 2026, after Antonio Denarium resigned. On April 30, 2026, the TSE (Brazil's Superior Electoral Court) removed him from office.
